restoration.title: Learning to ask better questions
restoration.text:
When our science club began, I thought a good question had to sound difficult. [[1]] Our teacher listened and asked us to look around the room.
I noticed a plant leaning towards the window. [[2]] That question was much simpler than the ones I had prepared, but we could investigate it.
We put two similar plants in different places and recorded what happened. [[3]] We had to check the light, the water and the time before making a claim.
The activity changed my idea of a good question. [[4]] Now, when I am curious about something, I first ask what I can observe or compare.
I still enjoy big questions. [[5]] A small question can be a useful place to begin.
options: I had even copied a few long words into my notebook.
Why was it growing in that direction?
The answer did not appear immediately.
It should help us notice something and think carefully.
But I no longer believe that long words make them better.
The bus driver asked us to sit down.
We decided that plants never need water.
reasons: 承接开头对难问题的误解，补充自己准备长单词的行为。
紧接植物朝窗户倾斜的观察，提出针对这个现象的问题。
承接观察实验，并引出后文需要检查多个条件。
承接对好问题看法的变化，给出新的判断标准。
与仍喜欢大问题形成转折，并呼应开头对长词的误解。
公交车司机与科学社团的观察、实验和提问没有衔接。
否定植物需要水不符合后文检查水和光照的实验过程。

restoration.title: A place for everyone to speak
restoration.text:
Our class discussion was often led by the same three students. [[1]] I usually had an idea, but by the time I was ready, the topic had changed.
One day, our teacher gave us a new rule. [[2]] During that time, we wrote one idea and one question on a card.
Then we talked in groups of four before sharing with the class. [[3]] I found it easier to explain my idea after trying it with three classmates.
The new rule did not mean that every idea was equally strong. [[4]] We still had to support our opinions with reasons.
After a month, more students were joining the discussion. [[5]] It had given us a better way to use our voices.
options: The rest of us listened, even when we had something to add.
Everyone would have two quiet minutes to think first.
Each person had a turn to speak in the smaller group.
It meant that everyone had a chance to make an idea clear.
The change had not simply made the room noisier.
The sports shop was closed for the weekend.
We no longer needed to explain any of our choices.
reasons: 对比同样三位学生发言与其余人的状态，并引出作者难以加入。
说明新规则的思考时间，为后文 During that time 提供指代。
承接四人小组，解释为什么作者更容易先练习自己的表达。
解释平等发言机会的含义，与后文仍需给理由衔接。
与后面的更好使用声音呼应，区分热闹和有效参与。
体育用品店与课堂讨论的组织方式没有关系。
与后文明说仍须用理由支持观点直接矛盾。

shortAnswers.title: A repair morning
shortAnswers.text: The community library opens a repair table every Sunday morning. People can bring small lamps, bags or toys. Volunteers begin by asking what has gone wrong. They do not promise to fix everything, but they explain what they are trying and why. Visitors are asked to bring an old towel to protect the table during cleaning. Last week, a student learned how to replace a loose button on a bag. She then showed her younger brother what to do. The library hopes the activity will help people use things for longer instead of throwing them away too soon.
items: 活动设在什么地方？用原文中的一个英文名词回答。
library
The community library opens a repair table
定位第一句的地点。community 是修饰语，问题要求地点名词。
活动每周哪天举行？用原文中的一个英文单词回答。
Sunday
every Sunday morning
every 后面的 Sunday 给出每周的日期。
访客要带什么物品保护桌面？只填英文名词单数。
towel
bring an old towel to protect the table
问题问自带的物品，不是拿来修的东西。
学生学会更换书包上什么松动的东西？只填英文名词单数。
button
replace a loose button on a bag
replace 后的 button 是被更换的物品。

shortAnswers.title: The outdoor notebook
shortAnswers.text: Our nature club keeps a shared notebook in the school office. Every Friday, a small group takes it to the park. Members record one change they notice, such as a new leaf or a bird building a nest. They include the date and a simple drawing. Photographs are welcome, but they are not required. At the next meeting, the group compares its notes with earlier pages. The aim is to observe carefully, not to collect the largest number of pictures. In winter, members sometimes notice less obvious changes, including the direction of shadows. The notebook helps them see that familiar places are never quite the same.
items: 共享笔记本平时放在哪里？用原文中的一个英文名词回答。
office
in the school office
school 修饰 office，问题要求地点名词。
小组每周哪天去公园？用原文中的一个英文单词回答。
Friday
Every Friday
第一段明确给出了去公园的日期。
除了简单图画，每条记录必须包含什么？只填英文名词单数。
date
They include the date and a simple drawing.
题目已给出 drawing，另一个并列信息是 date。
冬天的一种观察对象是什么的方向？只填英文名词复数。
shadows
including the direction of shadows
of 后的 shadows 表示观察方向的对象，需保留复数。
